review_notes: I read the whole file. It has one new definition, `spinRotationPath`. It builds a `Path` in `spinGroup Q` by applying `Path.map` to `Path.segment 0 π` and then `Path.cast`. It uses Mathlib's `Path`, `Path.segment`, `Path.map`, `Path.cast` and `Joined` directly, so it is not a competing path notion. The rest of the file is theorems (continuity, the evaluation formula, the Spin(2) and Spin(n+2) joinedness results) and two private helper lemmas. None of these is a concept-level duplicate, and the rubric excludes standalone theorem duplication. The objects `spinRotation`, `spinGroup.negOne` and `realCliffordSpinGroupZero` come from imported TauCeti files, not from this file. A grep of the Mathlib CliffordAlgebra directory for `negOne` found nothing. I did not look for competing Spin-group definitions in the other files. I found no avoidable competing version of a Mathlib concept in this file.
